title: When the soul needs company strong enough to cool it
issueStatement: Alone, the mind keeps recycling itself. In the wrong company, it becomes louder, sharper, and more forgetful of what it actually needs.
centralInsight: Gurbani treats sangat as placement, not generic belonging. Right company changes the inner climate: truth becomes speakable, Naam feels near, and the mind stops feeding only itself.
practicalReflection: Not every circle nourishes. Some company strengthens noise, ego, and drift; holy company makes return easier than self-invention.
actionPrompt: Move one concrete step toward company that makes remembrance more natural and self-deception harder to keep.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Practicing closeness to the right company
practice.issueStatement: Sangat helps most when it becomes a pattern, not an occasional rescue. Otherwise the heart keeps reverting to its older atmosphere.
practice.centralInsight: The soul is always being formed by company. Gurbani asks you to return often enough that holy presence becomes a real influence instead of a rare interruption.
practice.practicalReflection: A practice of sangat is less about collecting uplifting moments and more about staying near speech, people, and places that keep the mind honest.
practice.actionPrompt: Choose one recurring form of holy company and keep it long enough for your inner climate to change.
